items.title: Lululemon Athletica (LULU) Resets Leadership, Is The Stock A Bargain?
items.summary: New CEO appointment and board changes put governance in focus lululemon athletica (LULU) has just completed a major leadership shift, with Heidi O’Neill stepping in as chief executive officer and joining the board as a Class II director. The board expanded from 11 to 12 directors to accommodate her appointment, and interim co CEOs Meghan Frank and Andre Maestrini ended their temporary roles as O’Neill’s tenure began on September 8, 2026. items.title: 1 Consumer Stock to Research Further and 2 We Question
items.summary: Retailers are evolving to meet the expectations of modern, tech-savvy shoppers. Still, secular trends are working against them as e-commerce continues to take share from brick-and-mortar stores. This puts retail stocks in a tough spot, and over the past six months, the industry’s 3.5% gain has trailed the S&P 500 by 9.8 percentage points.
